newsitem.title: UK: Platinum fixes at near 2-1/2 year low.
newsitem.headline: Platinum fixes at near 2-1/2 year low.

text.p: Platinum fixed at the lowest level for nearly 2-1/2 years on Monday morning as weakness in silver pressured the rest of the precious metals complex.
Platinum fixed at $386.50 per ounce, the lowest since April 20, 1994, compared to $387.25 on Friday afternoon.
Platinum fixes at near 2-1/2 year low =2
"The mood is not good," an analyst in continental Europe said.
Heavy selling by US investment funds and other speculators last week shaved 13 cents off the price of spot silver, pushing it below the key $5.00 per ounce level.
In addition, major platinum producer Russia was rumoured to be stepping up selling to earn hard cash to plug holes in its budget.
Palladium fixed at $118.75 per ounce, down 75 cents from Friday, silver was quoted at $4.88 per ounce, up one cent from London's closing levels on Friday and gold was at $381.25, down 50 cents.
